reasons.action: No visual reference is present; only an audio voice-timbre reference. The action is therefore request-governed, even though the request only specifies reusing the voice for the man at the counter.
reasons.medium: With no visual reference and a medium_decision of no_reference, there is no observed medium to retain or transform. The medium is request-governed and defaults to Live-action, cinematic.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference exists, so wardrobe is request-governed. The request does not specify wardrobe, and the audio reference cannot supply it.
reasons.lighting: No visual reference exists, and the request specifies no illuminating source, direction, or light quality. Lighting is request-governed and defaults to the cinematic style.
reasons.framing: No visual reference exists, so framing is request-governed. The 16:9 aspect is canvas configuration, not a framing instruction.
reasons.palette: No visual reference exists, and the request gives no palette instruction. Palette is request-governed and defaults to the cinematic style.
